commit.message: JDK-8397500: Add AD file verification and regeneration tool

JDK-8397500: Use explicit generation markers

Introduce structured BEGIN/END markers that identify both the
generation mode and the source m4 file.

Sections now use markers of the form:
    BEGIN Section generated automatically from <file>_ad.m4
    END Section generated automatically from <file>_ad.m4

Whole-file generation uses markers of the form:
    BEGIN File generated automatically from <file>_ad.m4
    END File generated automatically from <file>_ad.m4

This allowsto reliably distinguish between files that are entirely
generated from a single m4 source and files that contain one or more
generated sections originating from different m4 sources.

To make generated AD/M4 pairs easier to identify, M4 source files are
named using the '_ad.m4' suffix.
